An inviting layout brings together comfortable living spaces and thoughtful functionality for everyday enjoyment. The open living and dining areas offer a welcoming setting to relax, gather with friends, or entertain, with a natural flow to space. A downstairs bedroom and full bathroom provide added versatility for guests, a home office, or a convenient retreat without the need to navigate stairs.
